## D — Emergencies, crashes and enforcement stops
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Emergency procedures retain their failure trigger and sequence. Clinical wound assessment, pressure technique and shock intervention are held for current qualified evidence; the dossier retains calling help, immediate-danger movement exceptions and not giving drinks. Generic flare advice never overrides hazardous-load flame-device restrictions.
Dynamic disposition: Vehicle-specific controls and current crash-reporting or move-over applicability require the stated equipment and source conditions; no generic deployment or skid-prevention guarantee is asserted.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.

corpus_stability.reason: This is a bounded snapshot of the issuer-linked Montana handbook. Its revision conflict is explicitly held as debt; there is no evidence in the supplied source of multiple substantive rewrites per year. Currency of individual changeable provisions is not inferred from this assessment.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page ninety describes injury prioritization, breathing/bleeding checks, wound pressure and keeping warm against shock without a current first-aid protocol. Specific clinical intervention instruction requires current qualified emergency-care evidence.
Physical page eighty-eight lists different clock-hand positions by airbag equipment. Vehicle-specific current owner instructions must resolve applicability before fixed hand positions are asserted.
Physical pages eighty-eight/eighty-nine contain absolute no-skid and will-inflate wording. No universal ABS/ESC skid-prevention or airbag-deployment guarantee is asserted.

Physical page ninety reporting thresholds and move-over rules are preserved with exact conditions; current statutory applicability and any later amendment still require verification before public release.
